cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(pure_soci_quick LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreadedDLL")
set(P0_NATIVE "" CACHE PATH "Prepared diagnostic native sources/builds")
set(P0_VARIANT "353-o2-nodebug" CACHE STRING "Existing SQLite control")
add_executable(pure_soci ../pure_soci.cpp)
target_compile_features(pure_soci PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(pure_soci PRIVATE "${P0_NATIVE}" "${P0_NATIVE}/soci/include" "${P0_NATIVE}/build/include")
target_link_libraries(pure_soci PRIVATE "${P0_NATIVE}/build/lib/Release/soci_sqlite3.lib" "${P0_NATIVE}/build/lib/Release/soci_core.lib" "${P0_NATIVE}/build/fmt/Release/fmt.lib" "${P0_NATIVE}/variants/${P0_VARIANT}/sqlite3.lib")
